syllabus.topics: Origin of Statistics & its application area, Data and its sources: primary and secondary. Data collection methods: designing a questionnaire and schedule. Scales of measurements. Types of variable: discrete variable, continuous variable, qualitative variable, quantitative variable. Construction and properties of tables. Distribution of variables. Discrete distribution, continuous distribution, cumulative distribution.

Graphical summarization of data: histogram, frequency polygon, frequency curve, ogives, stem-and-leaf plot, box plot, bar chart, multiple bar chart, stack bar plot, pie chart, line chart, diagrammatic and graphical representation of grouped data, frequency and cumulative frequency distribution and their applications.

Concept of central tendency and its measures, partition values, dispersion and relative dispersion, moments, Sheppard’s correction for moments, skewness, kurtosis and their measures. Theory of attributes: Independence and Association of attributes, various measures of association for two-way classified data.

Regression: purpose and scope, simple linear regression and concept of error, principle of least square and fitting of linear regression. Properties of regression equations, properties of regression coefficients, predicted and residual variances.
